title: Complementary disclosures in financial networks: accounting geometry, prior-weighted uncertainty and bounded-error reports
description: Unrefereed mathematical research candidate. Explicit fixed-total financial-network constructions separate accounting geometry, report-menu restrictions and multiplicative clearing as sources of complementary disclosures. The paper corrects the prior-weighted submodularity criterion at zero factors, derives affine-simplex residual-width and identification formulas using standard linear-programming duality, and treats heterogeneous bounded reporting errors over their full nonnegative range. Exact finite checks and retained rational solver witnesses supplement written proofs; unresolved solver outcomes are preserved. All networks are synthetic. Prior-weighted full-fibre uncertainty is not posterior-support width or welfare value. The results do not establish a general scalable algorithm for nonlinear clearing, empirical policy benefit, formal verification, independent reproduction or external peer-review acceptance. Original prose and data are CC0-1.0; original code is MIT.
